source: Official UPTAC 2026 (AKTU/Uttar Pradesh Technical Admission Counselling) opening-closing rank report on the Samarth portal (uptac.samarth.edu.in cut-off-matrix, 'Admission 2026-2027'), scraped directly 2026-10-12: programme B.Tech, category OPNO (Open, no sub-category = gender-neutral open seat), Co-Education seats, exam JEE-MAIN. Ranks are JEE Main CRL. 'closing' = highest rank allotted across the four JEE-Main counselling rounds R1-R4 (R4 = last main round); each round's table lists only that round's fresh allotments, so the max is the worst rank actually admitted. Round 6 (special round, which also admits Board/CUET-merit candidates) is excluded but noted where it went higher. The official UPTAC 2025 OR-CR (admissions.nic.in orcrreport.aspx) could not be fetched from this environment, so 2026 is used; spot-checks against Careers360's reproductions of UPTAC 2025 (ABES, GL Bajaj, IMS, KIET) show the same ranges. One entry (KIET) is 2025 mirror data because KIET left UPTAC in 2026. The official OR-CR has no All India / Home State split.
